title: Quantitative Techniques for Managers
modules: 2 Measures of Central Tendency and Dispersion

sessions.topic: Intro to quantitative techniques; descriptive vs inferential statistics; role of data analytics
Dispersion: range, variance, standard deviation, coefficient of variation; applications
Normal distribution, z-scores, business applications, central limit theorem
Data collection; data sources; data cleaning and preparation
Hypothesis testing: steps, type I and II errors, p-values, confidence intervals
Parametric tests (t-tests, ANOVA, regression) and non-parametric tests (chi-square)
Optimisation in business; LP formulation; business applications of LP
Graphical solution method; Excel Solver for LP
Assignment model (Hungarian method); transportation model (NW corner, least cost, Vogel's)
Decision theory: maximin, maximax, minimax regret; decision trees, EMV, EOL

note: Module 2.1 covers central tendency; a dispersion deck (likely Module 2.2) is not in the folders. Whether Module 3 reaches the normal distribution is checked during its lesson pass. Modules 7 to 10 have no decks yet; the EST covers the entire syllabus.
